generalAbilities.name: Glide
generalAbilities.description: The flynkett stretches its flaps to glide through the air. It moves 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. The flynkett can remain in the air long as it spends at least 1 action Gliding each round and does not Kettle Up.

generalAbilities.name: Kettle Up
generalAbilities.description: The flynkett uses its skin flaps to form a crude kettle. While Kettled Up, the flynkett can't use its claw Strike or take move actions. If the flynkett has been Kettled Up for 1 minute or longer, and its kettle is full of water (usually due to the flynkett being in the rain), the flynkett's kettle begins to boil, emitting a piercing whistle that causes all creatures within 30 feet to take a –2 penalty to Perception checks to hear sources other than the flynkett; this is an auditory effect. The flynkett can stop Kettling Up as a free action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Spill
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The flynkett is Kettled Up

Trigger The flynkett takes physical damage or is knocked Prone

Effect The flynkett spills the contents of its full skin flaps, releasing its digestive juices in a cloud of acidic vapor that deals 2d8 Acid Damage damage to all non-flynkett creatures within 20 feet (Basic DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw save). If the flynkett was boiling, the damage is increased to 4d8.
